links.comparator_used: Mahalanobis distance on raw or average-pooled bottleneck features (no dimensionality reduction); also compared MD against a KNN distance alternative
links.outcome: Detection of out-of-distribution images on which the segmentation models failed, and scalability
links.effect: Dimensionality reduction with PCA or UMAP gave high detection performance with minimal computational load. KNN drastically improved scalability and performance over MD on raw and average-pooled features. No numeric values are given in the text.
links.quote: KNN drastically improved scalability and performance over MD when both were applied to raw and average-pooled bottleneck features.

design_hint: out-of-distribution detection to warn clinicians of segmentation failure
